A.name: A
A.query:
WITH
  toInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) AS end_ms,
  series AS (
    SELECT fingerprint,
           any(if(JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name') != '', JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name'), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.id'))) AS host
    FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4
    WHERE metric_name IN ('loom.queue.issues', 'loom.host.uptime_seconds')
    GROUP BY fingerprint
  ),
  pts AS (
    SELECT series.host AS host, s.metric_name AS metric, s.unix_milli AS ms
    FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4 AS s
    INNER JOIN series USING (fingerprint)
    WHERE s.metric_name IN ('loom.queue.issues', 'loom.host.uptime_seconds')
      AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}}
      AND s.unix_milli < {{.end_timestamp_ms}}
  ),
  per_host AS (
    SELECT host,
           arraySort(groupUniqArrayIf(ms, metric = 'loom.queue.issues')) AS ticks,
           maxIf(ms, metric = 'loom.host.uptime_seconds') AS last_health_ms
    FROM pts
    WHERE host != ''
    GROUP BY host
  )
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(end_ms, 1000)) AS ts,
       host,
       toFloat64(intDiv(end_ms - arrayMax(ticks), 1000)
                 - greatest(300, 2 * intDiv(if(length(ticks) >= 3,
                                               toInt64(arrayReduce('quantileExact(0.5)', arrayPopFront(arrayDifference(ticks)))),
                                               60000), 1000))) AS value
FROM per_host
WHERE length(ticks) > 0
  AND last_health_ms >= end_ms - 600000
ORDER BY host

annotations.description: Host {{$labels.host}} is still exporting host.health (loom.host.uptime_seconds within 10 min) but its work finder has not ticked for {{$value}} s past its deadline. The deadline is 2x the host's own tick interval, learned as the median gap between its loom.queue.issues samples in the 24 h window (60 s if fewer than 3 ticks), floored at 300 s. A host whose work finder never ticked in the window (disabled) is not judged, nor is a host that stopped heartbeating (that is a dead host, not a stalled finder). A stalled finder on the ETA authority leaves every Ready ETA stale_inputs (see Loom Ready-stage ETAs stale or unanswered). Common cause: a full worktree disk (Loom host worktree disk critical, host.health halt_reason disk_full). Run `loom-daemon health` on the host; see troubleshooting.md 'Worker disk full'. Issue #10973 (2026-10-08: loom-worker-1's finder stopped at 14:04Z while it kept heartbeating; nothing alerted).
